changelog: Introduced new DashboardSections.kt file containing reusable UI components for the server dashboard.
Updated ServerDashboardScreen to utilize DashboardHeroCard, DashboardMetricCard, and DashboardShortcutTile for improved layout and functionality.
Added new icons and buttons for power controls, resource metrics, and navigation shortcuts.
Implemented confirmation dialogs for server shutdown and kill actions, enhancing user interaction.
